<script type="text/javascript"><!--
(function($) {
	function isGlsSelected() {
		return $('input[name=\'shipping_method\']:checked').val() == 'gls.gls';
	}

	function toggleGls() {
		if (isGlsSelected()) {
			$('#gls-drop-parcel-shop').show();
			$('#gls-error').toggle(!$('input[name=\'gls\']').val());
		} else {
			$('#gls-drop-parcel-shop').hide();
			$('#gls-error').hide();
		}
	}

	function formatGlsPoint(point) {
		var contact = point && point.contact ? point.contact : {};
		var location = $.trim(((contact.postalCode || '') + ' ' + (contact.city || '')).replace(/\s+/g, ' '));
		var parts = [];

		if (location) {
			parts.push(location);
		}

		if (contact.address) {
			parts.push(contact.address);
		}

		if (point && point.name) {
			parts.push(point.name);
		}

		return parts.join(', ') + ';' + (point && point.id ? point.id : '');
	}

	function saveGlsPoint(point) {
		var gls = formatGlsPoint(point);

		if (!point || !point.id) {
			$('input[name=\'gls\']').val('');
			$('#gls-error').show();
			return;
		}

		$('input[name=\'gls\']').val(gls).trigger('change');
		$('#gls-error').hide();

		$.ajax({
			url: 'index.php?route=checkout/shipping_method/saveGlsPoint',
			type: 'post',
			data: { gls: gls },
			dataType: 'json'
		});
	}

	$(document).ready(function() {
		toggleGls();
		$('input[name=\'shipping_method\']').on('change', toggleGls);

		$(document).off('click.glsShipping', '#gls-dpm-open').on('click.glsShipping', '#gls-dpm-open', function() {
			var dialog = document.getElementById('gls-dpm-dialog');

			if (dialog && dialog.showModal) {
				dialog.showModal();
			}
		});

		var dialog = document.getElementById('gls-dpm-dialog');

		if (dialog && !dialog._bebesGlsBound) {
			dialog.addEventListener('change', function(event) {
				saveGlsPoint(event.detail);
			});

			dialog._bebesGlsBound = true;
		}
	});

	if (!document.querySelector('script[data-bebes-gls-dpm]')) {
		var e = document.createElement('script');
		e.type = 'module';
		e.src = 'https://map.gls-hungary.com/widget/gls-dpm.js';
		e.setAttribute('data-bebes-gls-dpm', '1');
		document.getElementsByTagName('head')[0].appendChild(e);
	}
})(jQuery);
//--></script>
<?php } ?>
